title: cbtone
description: Hawkish/dovish tone signals from public central-bank communication (dictionary, transformer, local-LLM and fine-tuned scorers), with contamination-aware evaluation and event-study tools. Companion software to the paper "Do Local-LLM Tone Scores of Central-Bank Communication Carry Policy Signal? Pre-registered Evidence from Seven Central Banks in Three Languages" (https://thanatchon36.github.io/cbtone/paper/).
